claims.claim: Floquet-Bloch replica bands are observed at E_D ± ℏω in the tr-ARPES spectrum
claims.evidence: Processed band data shows n=±1 replicas at E=-0.2907 eV and E=0.2053 eV, separated by 0.496 eV = 2×0.248 eV

claims.claim: Replica band separation matches exactly 2ℏω (pump photon energy)
claims.evidence: Measured separation = 0.4960 eV, expected = 0.4960 eV, deviation = 0.000%

claims.claim: Polarization dependence follows cos²(2θ) pattern consistent with Volkov final states
claims.evidence: Volkov model fit R² = 0.999950, LAPE model R² = 0.047, ΔAIC = 69.0 favoring Volkov

claims.claim: Replica bands appear symmetrically around the Dirac point in momentum
claims.evidence: n=-1 replicas at kx=±0.0463 Å⁻¹, n=+1 replicas at kx=±0.0342 Å⁻¹

claims.claim: Pump-on spectra show enhanced intensity relative to pump-off
claims.evidence: Total spectral weight ratio I_on/I_off ranges from 1.16 to 1.22 depending on polarization

claims.claim: The scattering mechanism involves photon-dressed Volkov final states rather than LAPE
claims.evidence: cos²(2θ) periodicity (Volkov) strongly preferred over cos²(θ) (LAPE) by ΔAIC=69
